specification.source_method: OpenAPI document embedded in Swagger UI

operations.summary: Obtain the list of all commodities from the agmarknet platform
Obtain the list of all states and districts available.
Obtain the list of markets for a given commodity, state and district.

parameters.name: commodity_id
parameters.description: Commodity ID (required). List can be obtained from /commodities endpoint.

parameters.name: state_id
parameters.description: State ID (required). List can be obtained from /geographies endpoint.

parameters.name: district_id
parameters.description: District ID (required). List can be obtained from /geographies endpoint.

operations.summary: Obtain the prices for a commodity at the national, state, district or the market level.

parameters.name: state_id
parameters.description: State ID (required). Use 0 for all India level data or state level integer value obtained from /geographies

parameters.name: district_id
parameters.description: Optional district IDs. If not provided, will fetch data at the national or the state level. If provided, will fetch data at the district level.

parameters.name: market_id
parameters.description: Optional market IDs. If not provided, will fetch data directly at the district level. If provided, will fetch data for the particular markets within that district.

operations.summary: Obtain the quantities for a commodity at the national, state, district or market level.

parameters.name: state_id
parameters.description: State ID (required). Use 0 for all India level data or state level integer value obtained from /geographies

parameters.name: district_id
parameters.description: Optional district IDs. If not provided, will fetch data at the national or the state level. If provided, will fetch data at the district level.

parameters.name: market_id
parameters.description: Optional market IDs. If not provided, will fetch data directly at the district level. If provided, will fetch data for the particular markets within that district.

assumptions: The user-requested 12-month period means the corresponding calendar date one year before today through today, inclusive.
The user states price units should be Rs per quintal; the OpenAPI response schema itself does not document a unit.
Candidate-match scores are string-similarity indicators, not verified agronomic equivalence; multiple IDs are left unselected.
The national run used state_id=0 and the user-authorized documented read-only POST; state-specific price requests were deferred by user choice.
CEDA authentication uses an Authorization Bearer token as declared by the OpenAPI security scheme.
State ID 0 is the national aggregate because the prices request-body schema documents that meaning; this value was used for the national price requests.
A freshness warning is raised for national data older than 30 days before the requested end date; this is a conservative heuristic because the API spec documents no freshness SLA.

summary.recommendation: The latest returned quotes may be stale; do not treat them as current prices. For ambiguous mappings, choose the intended commodity explicitly. For stale, missing, or unavailable prices, use a cache only after verifying its freshness; otherwise use the labelled mock price.

runtime_schema_differences: CEDA returned commodities under output.data with commodity_id/commodity_name, rather than the documented top-level commodities list with id/name.
CEDA returned geographies in a wrapped response rather than the documented top-level geographies list.
